question: How do public self-improvement systems respond when local improvement stalls: stop, widen/redirect search, or reopen the improvement policy/architecture, and what evidence isolates the causal value of that response?

rows.long_horizon: loop can continue, but no source-bound >10-iteration matched reopen-vs-stop causal run identified
rows.trigger: auto-trigger harness-architect after 3 consecutive iterations within 1% or a score drop; separate rules can also stop on plateau
rows.trigger_evidence_surface: single 30% held_out split repeatedly reused for candidate selection
rows.meta_transition: architect can change topology family such as single-call, chain, RAG, ReAct, hierarchical, or parallel
rows.promotion_gate: repeated held-out winner comparison; no candidate-local anytime-valid statistical certificate identified
rows.outer_test_isolation: no distinct third untouched split in audited setup
rows.main_value: concrete public implementation of plateau/regression causing proposal-family reconsideration
rows.scope_guard: do not attribute reported harness gains specifically to architect reopening

rows.long_horizon: meta-horizon arms imply 6, 12, or 24 fast iterations for H=2,4,8 when meta-update count is fixed at 3
rows.trigger: Allocator widens child budget after stagnation and frontier meta-productivity redirects effort; slow loop rewrites five meta-skill files every fixed H iterations from recent descendant improvement
rows.meta_transition: rewrites Analyzer, Retriever, Allocator, Proposer, Evolver policies
rows.promotion_gate: archive admits children with positive utility improvement on validation
rows.outer_test_isolation: train/validation/test are disjoint and test is reported as unseen by evolution
rows.matched_reopen_vs_stop_ablation: partial only: full meta-skill adaptation is compared with Single-Level frozen slow loop, but the cadence sweep is not full candidate/evaluation-budget matched
rows.cadence_boundary: H=2/4/8 uses 6/12/24 fast iterations with 3 meta-updates, so the sweep holds meta-update count fixed rather than total fast-loop proposal/evaluation compute
rows.main_value: strongest source-bound held-out evidence found this run that adapting the improvement policy itself adds value beyond a frozen slow loop
rows.scope_guard: scheduled meta-updates are not an evidence-triggered plateau-reopen control law

rows.trigger: meta-evolver rewrites the evolver strategy on the regular outer loop rather than a >10-iteration matched plateau trigger
rows.trigger_evidence_surface: previous task/evolver trajectories under a frozen anchor
rows.meta_transition: task harness and evolver strategy are separate mutable scopes
rows.promotion_gate: best-version selection; no candidate-local anytime-valid certificate identified
rows.outer_test_isolation: held-out evaluation exists in the paper's Setup B; exact scope depends on experiment
rows.matched_reopen_vs_stop_ablation: meta-on/meta-off exists, but not >10 iterations and not plateau-stop versus matched evidence-triggered reopen
rows.main_value: direct evidence that changing the improvement strategy can add gain beyond task-level evolution
rows.scope_guard: do not generalize from five outer iterations to long-horizon adaptive reopening

rows.long_horizon: published runs include 14, 26, and 51 evolution cycles
rows.trigger: current public generic EvolutionLoop returns converged when recent score history is within its convergence epsilon/window
rows.trigger_evidence_surface: streaming/train task scores used by the evolution loop
rows.meta_transition: stateful multi-agent evolver and branching/routing exist, but generic convergence does not invoke a strategy-reopening architect
rows.promotion_gate: engine-specific; generic loop snapshots mutations rather than providing a universal anytime-valid promotion certificate
rows.outer_test_isolation: generic streaming loop has no inherent untouched final lockbox
rows.implementation_boundary: in the audited generic loop, config egl_window is threaded into convergence checking, while config egl_threshold is not passed to _is_score_converged and the function default epsilon remains 0.01 on this exact path
rows.main_value: real >10-cycle counterpoint where stagnation causes stopping rather than automatic policy reopening
rows.scope_guard: other engines/paths may use egl_threshold or different stopping logic; this statement is exact-path only

distinct_stagnation_responses: widen child budget or redirect among existing branches
rewrite the improvement policy or architecture
cross_system_synthesis.current_evidence_gap: No source-bound public real-LLM system found in this run simultaneously provides >10 proposals, an explicit plateau/evidence-triggered strategy reopen, a matched plateau-stop baseline at equal proposal/evaluation budget, candidate-local anytime-valid promotion evidence, durable cross-proposal statistical spending, complete proposal chronology, and an untouched outer test.

exact_next_action: Search for a same-system matched Stop-vs-Widen-vs-Reopen experiment under equal proposal/evaluation budgets, preferably >10 proposals and with promotion evidence, reopening evidence, and untouched outer evaluation as separate channels. Audit any candidate for candidate-local anytime-valid acceptance and restart-durable cross-proposal statistical spending. If no such experiment is public, extend this matrix with the next source-bound implementation that materially closes one missing column rather than repeating generic meta-learning results.
